Tuesday night was a [massive](https://zeteo.com/p/breaking-dems-take-full-
control-of-congress) win for Democrats and progressives in the U.S. - a blue
tsunami that exceeded expectations. It was a rebuke of Donald Trump and his
cronies' bigotry, including their anti-DEI crusade, their anti-immigrant
rhetoric, and their blatant misogyny.

[Subscribe now](https://zeteo.com/subscribe)

You've probably heard about the big races - Abdul El-Sayed's major win in
[Michigan](https://zeteo.com/p/blue-tsunami-watch-zeteos-coverage), James
Talarico in Texas, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia - but there are a whole
host of other major victories you may have missed that show not only how
massive this blue tsunami was, but just how unsuccessful Trump's [anti-
DEI](https://zeteo.com/p/trump-war-on-dei-racist-america-
history?utm_source=publication-search) campaign and racist policies have been.
Here are nine of them:
